messages.content: Help me execute the test runner `runThis` with arguments to set the wait time to 2 minutes and output the logs to a specific print stream `testLogStream`, considering the debuggee name is 'TestDebuggee'?

function.name: runThis

argv.description: An array of strings representing the command-line arguments, to include waittime and debuggeeName. Format: -waitTime, <waitTime>, -debuggeeName, TestDebuggee This is Java Array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

But we need to provide string representation. The tool expects the array of strings as a string representation. So we should pass something like 'new String[]{"-waitTime","2","-debuggeeName","TestDebuggee"}' or maybe just '["-waitTime","2","-debuggeeName","TestDebuggee"]'? The description says: "An array of strings representing the command-line arguments, to include waittime and debuggeeName. Format: -waitTime, <waitTime>, -debuggeeName, TestDebuggee This is Java Array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation." That is confusing. It might mean we need to pass a string representation of a Java array of strings. So we could pass 'new String[]{"-waitTime","2","-debuggeeName","TestDebuggee"}'. For out, we need to pass the PrintStream object. We have a specific print stream named testLogStream. So we pass 'testLogStream'.

Thus the function call:

{
  "argv": "new String[]{\"-waitTime\",\"2\",\"-debuggeeName\",\"TestDebuggee\"}",
